[USER] The user asked about the difference between Gore-Tex and eVent membranes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant explained the differences between Gore-Tex and eVent membranes:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Gore-Tex: Original and widely used, microporous membrane, highly durable, used in various outdoor gear.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - eVent: Newer technology, direct venting system, lighter and more breathable, growing adoption among outdoor brands.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant compared Gore-Tex and eVent, noting breathability, weight, durability, and price differences.
